posts.trend: How Indians can build a diabetes-friendly lifestyle without extreme diets
posts.context: Urban Indians are hitting their thirties and realizing their bodies are starting to break down from a decade of poor lifestyle choices.
posts.angle: What was once a simple treat becomes an active financial threat to your future.
slides: There is a word that changes its meaning when you turn thirty.

"Sweet."

At 15: A reward for passing your school exams.

At 22: A late-night treat with college friends.

At 30: A threat to your HDFC health insurance premium.

You didn't even get to eat it.

The doctor just warned you about the smell.
posts.caption: The transition from sugar rush to sugar monitoring is extremely fast. 🩺
posts.rank_verdict: The middle slide is too wordy and breaks the rhythm of short, sharp sentences.
